Lag. <cite ref="O00067"><he>סבכא</he></cite>, Var. <he>ספכא</he>, corr. acc.) a gold-embroidered hair net; <cite ref="Shabbat 57b">Sabb. 57ᵇ</cite>. Y. ib. VI, 8ᵇ bot.; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:11">Neg. XI, 11</cite>, a. fr. <he>שביס של ס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="U00124"><he>שָׁבִיס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 15</cite> <he>שביס של ש׳</he>. Sabb. l. c. <he>כל שהוא למטה מן הש׳</he> whatever ornament is worn beneath the net; ib. 65ᵃ <he>הס׳</he>; (Tosef. ib. IV (V), 7 <he>חיפוי שלמטה משערה</he>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:9">Kel. XXVIII, 9</cite> <he>ס׳ של זקנה</he> the old woman’s net-work (mat to sit upon, v. Maim. a. l.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:9">Ib.</cite> <he>חלוק … העשוי כס׳</he> the public woman’s shirt which is like net-work (gauze, v. <cite ref="H00430"><he>חוּץ</he> II</cite>).
